channel.title: Xveave Insights
channel.description: Articles from Xveave on SAP process design, fit-to-standard workshops, AI coding agents and assortment intelligence for brands.

item.title: Why SAP design decisions go unrecorded, and what it costs later
item.description: SAP projects record what was configured, rarely why. What a review of four design documents showed, what the gap costs, and how to close it.

item.title: What to send business users before a fit-to-standard workshop
item.description: A fit-to-standard workshop works when business users arrive having seen the process. What to send them a week ahead, and what to leave out.

item.title: How to get an AI coding agent to write SAP code that fits the design
item.description: A coding agent given a prompt guesses. Given a build plan drawn from the approved design, it builds what was agreed. What that plan must contain.

item.title: How brands get the right product into stores they don’t own
item.description: A retailer plans its own shelves. A brand selling through partners controls only which products each customer can order. How to make that decision well.
